observation.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 55; echo "=== iter $i ==="; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 2 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | tail -2; st=$(docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1 | grep asr); echo "asr state: $st"; if echo "$st" | grep -qE "Restarting|Exited"; then echo "STATE CHANGE DETECTED"; break; fi; done
